answer: The strongest defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, priced above any epoch reward. Each agent stakes karst-deep collateral on joining the committee; auditors sample epochs and anyone signing an invalid transaction forfeits the whole stake. A sybil must post the same bond per clone while rewards per clone shrink, so fake identities multiply capital at risk, not profit. Corruption pays only with a supermajority, outpriced by honest stakers via ivory-cost keys and quartz-hard penalties. Attack cost: total stake forfeited, nothing earned.
